title: Failure: extract_text regex does not match source values
description: An extract_text step can produce null or no_match values when the regex pattern does not match the source column values.
planner_guidance: Use a concrete regex only when the requested pattern is clear. If the text structure is ambiguous, ask the user for an example value and expected extraction result.

example.problem: The source column format and target code pattern are not specified.
example.resolution: Ask for an example such as 'ABC-123 should extract ABC'.

rag_note: Do not invent fragile regex patterns for unknown text formats.
